overview_description.description:
Organizations rely on HR Tech more than ever before. But it's never been harder to research, select & implement new tools. Buyers are often overwhelmed and unprepared, facing a crowded software marketplace and pushy salespeople

OutSail exists because buyers deserve more. More support, more insights, more resources & more expertise. OutSail's free HR Tech advisory services help businesses research, evaluate and select the right HR software for their needs. Come see why buying software with the help of a software broker is the way of the future.

Founded 2018, OutSail pioneered the software broker model. Our unique model allows our services to be both vendor-agnostic and cost-free to our customers.

product.name: HRIS Marketplace
product.description: A platform that provides access to a wide range of HR technology vendors and products to help organizations find suitable HR software solutions.

product.name: HRIS Evaluation Tools
product.description: A suite of tools that enable organizations to set criteria, score vendors, and collaborate on HR software evaluations to support informed purchasing decisions.

product.name: Advisory Services
product.description: Consulting services that assist organizations in navigating HR technology selection, negotiation, and post-purchase support including implementation and optimization.

product.name: Broker Model
product.description: A vendor-funded brokerage service that provides unbiased HR software recommendations and support to buyers at no cost, funded by equal commissions from software vendors.

product.name: HR Service Partner Finder
product.description: A service that matches organizations with appropriate HR consultants and service providers for implementation, optimization, or outsourcing needs.
